title: Go-cart pair
next_milestone: Set the shared requirements and sketch the two cart layouts.
help_needed: Chassis layout, steering, brakes, and CAD.
body:
## Scope
Design and build two go-carts. Scope, parts, and dimensions are still to be agreed.

## Next steps
- Define rider fit, intended surface, and prototype constraints.
- Compare steering and braking layouts before selecting parts.
- Model packaging and inspect component clearances.

## Bill of materials
Starter planning list. Quantities and specifications are TBD; these are not verified purchasing recommendations.

| Item | Quantity | Specification | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chassis material | TBD | Geometry and material selection TBD | Not selected |
| Wheels and hubs | TBD | Diameter, load rating, and mounting TBD | Not selected |
| Steering components | TBD | Geometry and linkage details TBD | Not selected |
| Braking components | TBD | Architecture and test criteria TBD | Not selected |
| Seat and restraints | TBD | Fit and mounting requirements TBD | Not selected |
| Drive components | TBD | Propulsion choice and layout TBD | Not selected |

## Resources

body:
## Scope
Infrared tag system with hit detection and scoring. Scope, parts, and dimensions are still to be agreed.

## Next steps
- Agree on range, scoring rules, and the first prototype test.
- Select a controller and compare candidate IR receivers.
- Log received signals before adding game logic.

title: Synthesizer night
description: DIY synthesizers, oscillators, and audio circuits.
next_milestone: Choose a first oscillator circuit and define the session format.
help_needed: Analog audio circuits, prototyping, and workshop planning.
body:
## Scope
DIY synthesizers, oscillators, and audio circuits. Scope, parts, and dimensions are still to be agreed.

## Next steps
- Agree on the workshop format and available test equipment.
- Choose a low-voltage prototype circuit and document its output limits.
- Test one sound source before adding controls or an enclosure.
